raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It features a three-layer architecture: the Observe Layer (desktop sensors for work patterns), the Intelligence Layer (detects employee intent, business value, and "drift"), and the Execution Layer (automates AI agent generation, deployment, and monitoring). It utilizes existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify high-ROI AI opportunities.
raw.evidence_of_stage: The venture is described as a concept and architecture, with no mention of a built product, users, or revenue in the intake form.
raw.thesis: Narma is creating an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that aims to help AI-first companies scale their AI automation efforts. The core innovation lies in its three-layer architecture: observing work patterns via desktop sensors, an "Intelligence Layer" that detects employee intent and business value of tasks, and an "Execution Layer" that automates the generation and deployment of AI agents. Instead of building its own foundation models, Narma leverages existing ones and focuses on analyzing the "Work Graph" to identify areas for high-ROI AI intervention. This venture directly addresses the challenges enterprises face in measuring AI savings, proving ROI, and managing the continuous drift in systems and human resources. The founder's goal appears to be a growth-oriented startup, given the focus on enterprise-scale AI deployment. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the founder having articulated a clear vision and architecture but no evidence of a built product or user traction. Narma is positioned to complement existing AI solutions by providing a layer of intelligence and automation that optimizes their deployment and impact within an enterprise.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the prospect of providing a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and continuously auto-builds agents for "Continuous AI lift."
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its focus on a three-layer "Enterprise Agentic Brain" architecture that observes work, understands intent, and autonomously deploys AI agents by leveraging existing foundation models and analyzing the "Work Graph" for high-ROI opportunities.
things_that_must_work: Effective integration with existing foundation models
Accurate and reliable desktop sensor data capture
Precise detection of employee intent and task value by the Intelligence Layer
Seamless and safe automated generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents
Enterprise adoption and trust in AI automation
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.

core_insight.source_excerpt: The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the 'Work Graph' to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance.
core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot effectively observe work patterns or the 'Work Graph' analysis fails to accurately identify valuable AI automation opportunities, then Narma will not be able to deliver continuous AI lift.
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on leveraging existing foundation models and analyzing the 'Work Graph' to identify and automate high-ROI AI opportunities, rather than building its own LLMs, which differentiates it from general AI platforms.
